summary: Enhance your analytics expertise with our Excel Power Query and Power Pivot training course. Learn to transform data into actionable insights effectively.
lede: Power Query and Power Pivot training helps data and reporting professionals prepare, model, and analyze information in Excel. It covers importing and cleaning data from multiple sources, combining datasets, building relationships in the Data Model, and creating DAX measures, pivot tables, and dashboards, including workflows for refreshing recurring reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work with data, reporting, analysis, or decision support across various sectors.
modules: Introduction to Power Pivot and the Data Model
Building Effective Pivot Tables and Dashboards
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of Excel and data analysis concepts.
